name: Singlehood
overview: Scripture acknowledges that it is not good for man to be alone, as God created a helper suitable for him, highlighting the original design for companionship (Genesis 2:18). Yet, God also cares deeply for the solitary, placing them within families and providing community (Psalms 68:6). The covenantal nature of marriage is affirmed as a sacred bond and companion relationship (Malachi 2:14), while contentment in any life circumstance, including singlehood, is a spiritual lesson learned through reliance on Christ (Philippians 4:11). Together, these verses teach that singlehood is not a deficiency but a state in which believers can find fulfillment and God’s provision.
